items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I was playing with a fella named Olatunji -- big African ensemble... I stayed with Olatunji for quite a while

ctx.x: See, I've been operated on a few times, leg business. I got three pins and I've been operated on about seven times, man. I mean heavy ones...

Around '68 I commenced to thinkin', then I had so much trouble with an organ player. I had an organ trio at the time at a place called the Purple Manor on 125th St. near Madison Avenue, and also at that particular time I was playing with a fella named Olatunji -- big African ensemble... I stayed with Olatunji for quite a while... And playing the African music is not easy, its way off. And I still had to do it by ear... but he liked the way I played. So I played some very important dates with Olatunji. For…
So were you reading chords then?
